$Comment: A skill daily on Old Jack's board, for a server running MMO Skill Tree: earn this much Artillery
XP while you carry it, any way you like. Its siblings aim at Harvesting, Mining and Crafting.
Old Jack's board posts this pack's other contracts in its night and day slots, and one of these
four every day in its skill slot, the Difficulty band Hallows_Eve_Skill that only these carry.
Weight sets how often each comes up against its three siblings.
Requires holds two switches at the top level. The event's running switch takes the contract out
of the draw whenever the event is off. hytale:mod_installed takes the whole file out on a server
without MMO Skill Tree, since its objective and its XP reward are that mod's; always write it
with Min 1. Its pay waits at Old Jack's board to be collected (Rewards.Claim), as every
contract's does: the board's own pay table, the same favor with Old Jack and the Hallowed as his
other contracts (the Reputation rewards; Amount is how much), plus XP in the skill it aims at.
